why_it_changes_the_answer: Different personal law (Hindu/Muslim/Christian/Parsi/Special Marriage Act) governs divorce, maintenance and succession differently
question_wording_en: Which religion or personal law governs this marriage — Hindu, Muslim, Christian, Parsi, or a court/special marriage?
question_wording_hi: इस विवाह पर कौन सा धर्म या व्यक्तिगत कानून लागू होता है — हिंदू, मुस्लिम, ईसाई, पारसी, या कोर्ट/विशेष विवाह?
answer_buttons: Hindu / Muslim / Christian / Parsi / Court or special marriage

why_it_changes_the_answer: Ancestral vs self-acquired vs marital property changes who can legally claim a share
question_wording_en: What is the relationship between the parties — ancestral/inherited property, self-acquired, or marital property?
question_wording_hi: पक्षों के बीच क्या संबंध है — पैतृक/विरासत में मिली संपत्ति, स्वयं अर्जित, या वैवाहिक संपत्ति?

why_it_changes_the_answer: A formal registered-ownership dispute vs a visitor-access issue triggers different Acts entirely
question_wording_en: Is there a formal dispute over the property's registered religious ownership, or is this about visitor access?
question_wording_hi: क्या संपत्ति के पंजीकृत धार्मिक स्वामित्व को लेकर औपचारिक विवाद है, या यह आगंतुक प्रवेश से संबंधित है?

why_it_changes_the_answer: Police action vs a private person changes applicable arrest powers and FIR-vs-complaint procedure
question_wording_en: Did the police arrest/detain you, or was it a private person?
question_wording_hi: क्या पुलिस ने आपको गिरफ्तार/हिरासत में लिया, या यह कोई निजी व्यक्ति था?

why_it_changes_the_answer: Formal written contract vs daily wage vs gig work changes which labour law applies
question_wording_en: Is this about a formal written employment contract, daily wages, or contractual/gig work?
question_wording_hi: क्या यह एक औपचारिक लिखित रोजगार अनुबंध, दैनिक मजदूरी, या ठेके/गिग कार्य के बारे में है?
answer_buttons: Written contract / Daily wages / Contract or gig work

why_it_changes_the_answer: Refusal to register an FIR vs registered-but-no-action leads to different remedies (e.g. BNSS 173(4) escalation vs a follow-up application)
question_wording_en: Did the police refuse to register your complaint, or did they register it but not take action?
question_wording_hi: क्या पुलिस ने आपकी शिकायत दर्ज करने से इनकार किया, या उन्होंने दर्ज कर ली लेकिन कोई कार्रवाई नहीं की?
answer_buttons: Refused to register / Registered but no action / Something else

why_it_changes_the_answer: Offence before vs after 1 July 2024 decides whether IPC or BNS provisions apply
question_wording_en: When did this happen — roughly the date or month?
question_wording_hi: यह कब हुआ — लगभग तारीख या महीना बताएं?

why_it_changes_the_answer: Sending money vs sharing bank details vs sharing an OTP changes the specific provision and the bank-complaint route
question_wording_en: Did you send money, share your bank details, or share an OTP?
question_wording_hi: क्या आपने पैसे भेजे, अपनी बैंक जानकारी साझा की, या OTP साझा किया?
answer_buttons: Sent money / Shared bank details / Shared an OTP / Something else

why_it_changes_the_answer: Security deposit vs advance rent vs another payment changes which remedy/forum applies
question_wording_en: Was this a security deposit, advance rent, or another payment?
question_wording_hi: क्या यह सिक्योरिटी डिपॉज़िट, एडवांस किराया, या कोई अन्य भुगतान था?
answer_buttons: Security deposit / Advance rent / Another payment

why_it_changes_the_answer: Rent and tenancy law is state-specific legislation
question_wording_en: Which state is the property in?
question_wording_hi: संपत्ति किस राज्य में स्थित है?

why_it_changes_the_answer: Written contract vs verbal/informal arrangement changes the evidence route and forum (labour authority vs civil suit)
question_wording_en: Do you have a written contract, or was this a verbal/informal arrangement?
question_wording_hi: क्या आपके पास लिखित अनुबंध है, या यह मौखिक/अनौपचारिक व्यवस्था थी?
answer_buttons: Written contract / Verbal agreement / Not sure

why_it_changes_the_answer: A legal notice within 30 days of the bounce is a mandatory precondition before a cheque-bounce case can be filed
question_wording_en: Have you already sent a legal notice to the person who gave the cheque?
question_wording_hi: क्या आपने चेक देने वाले व्यक्ति को पहले ही कानूनी नोटिस भेजा है?
answer_buttons: Yes, notice sent / No, not yet / Not sure

why_it_changes_the_answer: Most 'family' situations route through the same personal-law distinction already covered by the existing rule; no separate new fact proposed to avoid a duplicate/conflicting rule
SAFETY GATE, not a legal-fact question — must always be offered before any legal question when danger/coercion/a child may be involved, and is never withheld or skipped by the question cap
question_wording_en: Are you safe right now, or do you need help immediately?
question_wording_hi: क्या आप अभी सुरक्षित हैं, या आपको तुरंत मदद चाहिए?
answer_buttons: I am safe right now / I need help now (show helplines)
